subject: Provable usage escrow & closeplan for assessment materials
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Park <alicia@terracart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Provable usage escrow & closeplan for assessment materials

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Per our discussion, I wanted to put a short mutual action plan (MAP) on the table so we can exchange the evaluation materials (dataset + prompt pack + testcase set) with clear usage constraints and a close timeline. The goal is to enable a short, low-risk trial while protecting both parties and giving procurement what it needs to sign off.

High-level ask: Redwood provides ephemeral access to the assessment materials for a 2-week canary, then a 4-week full evaluation window. TerrafCart verifies acceptance criteria. We put the dataset in escrow (read-only access + transfer manifest) and commit to takedown after the expiry period.

Proposed MAP (high-level):
- Kickoff & intake: week 0 (transfer manifest + IP/PI checklist)
- Canary window: 2 weeks (limited tokens, sandbox only)
- Full evaluation window: 4 weeks (expanded token budget on dedicated sandbox)
- Acceptance gates: sample pass rate on 5 prompt families + manual review checklist
- Takedown & destruction: 30 days after window ends (certified deletion)

Usage constraints (must-haves):
- Ephemeral, non-retrain license: materials are not to be used for model training or derivation.
- Sandbox-only endpoints: no production calls, no data egress outside agreed sandbox.
- Token & access limits: initial canary = 10k prompt tokens; full window = 100k tokens.
- Audit trail: Redwood provides per-route audit logs for the evaluation period.

Attachments I will drop to the Drive link and attach here for easy review: MAP_v1.pdf (MAP + milestones), SOW-data-covenant.docx (legal covenant language), transfer_manifest.csv (file inventory).

Next steps:
1) Quick legal review on your side of the SOW data covenant (we kept the wording conservative).
2) Procurement contact for DocuSign handoff.
3) Confirm preferred kickoff date (we can start as early as 2025-10-20).

If that aligns, I’ll circulate the MAP + a HubSpot milestone card (DC-3821) and add Ben to coordinate credits and billing.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: MAP_v1.pdf (see Drive), SOW-data-covenant.docx, transfer_manifest.csv
From: Alicia Park <alicia@terracart.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Oct 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provable usage escrow & closeplan for assessment materials

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for pulling this together and for the clear MAP. This looks sensible and we’re interested in proceeding. A couple of things from our side:

1) Security ask: our security team needs the SOC 2 snapshot and confirmation that audit logs will show per-request metadata (token counts / IP / route). Can you attach the SOC 2 date-stamped snapshot?
2) Legal / procurement: I’ve looped in procurement (procurement@terracart.com) for DocuSign. They’ll do the formal review of the SOW-data-covenant wording.
3) Timeline: we’re aiming to finish a short evaluation before our Nov 20 partner review; the dates you proposed look doable but can you confirm the takedown/retention timings precisely?

Also, small ask on the token buckets — would Redwood consider a 3-week canary instead of 2 weeks for broader sampling?

I’ll wait for the SOC 2 snapshot and the MAP/SOW attachments. Once procurement is in, they’ll coordinate DocuSign.

Best,
Alicia Park
Head of ML Ops | TerraCart
alicia@terracart.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Park <alicia@terracart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Oct 2025 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provable usage escrow & closeplan for assessment materials

Alicia —

Quick follow-up with concrete MAP milestones and answers to your asks. We’ve attached the SOC 2 snapshot to the shared Drive (dated 2025-07-01). Below is the MAP with dates based on a 2025-10-20 kickoff: 

MAP (detailed) — kickoff on 2025-10-20:
- 2025-10-20: Kickoff + security intake (transfer_manifest.csv confirmed)
- 2025-10-22 to 2025-11-11: Canary window (3 weeks as requested) — limited token bucket (15k) on dedicated sandbox
- 2025-11-12 to 2025-12-09: Full evaluation window (4 weeks) — expanded token budget (100k)
- 2025-12-10: Acceptance review meeting; TerrafCart to provide pass/fail on acceptance checklist
- 2026-01-09: Certified takedown complete (within 30 days of window end) — Redwood provides deletion certificate and audit logs export

Acceptance criteria (sample):
- >= 85% pass rate on 5 representative prompt families on automated runs
- No critical data leakage or PII exposures in generated outputs
- Manual spot-checks (3 reviewers) confirm business-level correctness for top 50 responses

Legal / data covenant highlights (from SOW-data-covenant.docx):
- Use limited to evaluation; explicit prohibition on model training or derivation.
- Ephemeral access; no long-term storage of raw files outside TerraCart’s ephemeral sandbox.
- Redwood provides audit logs and deletion certificate; enforcement via scheduled takedown and verification export.

Attachments in Drive and copied here: MAP_v1.pdf, SOW-data-covenant.docx, transfer_manifest.csv (file inventory). I’ll also add the SOC 2 snapshot to the same folder.

If that looks good I’ll ask Legal to prep the DocuSign bundle (we’ll include the SOW data covenant + an addendum tying acceptance gates to the milestone payment schedule). Ben — can you handle the DocuSign + credit ask?

Thanks —
Soojin
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Park <alicia@terracart.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Oct 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provable usage escrow & closeplan for assessment materials

On Thu, Oct 9, 2025 at 9:12 AM Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com> wrote:
> High-level ask: Redwood provides ephemeral access to the assessment materials for a 2-week canary, then a 4-week full evaluation window.

Alicia — thanks for the thoughtful review. Two quick commercial points to speed this:

1) Canary extension: happy to move to a 3-week canary (15k token cap) as Soojin outlined.
2) Credits & billing: we’ll provide a $10k credit applied to evaluation usage; any overage will be billed at standard usage rates.
3) DocuSign: I’ve assembled the agreement bundle and created the DocuSign envelope (DocuSign_Terms.link). Once procurement signs we’ll auto-provision the sandbox and drop the transfer manifest.

Operational note — we will enforce the non-training covenant via contractual language and by restricting the sandbox endpoints so that logs include per-request metadata (route, token count, timestamp). We’ll provide an audit export at takedown.

If procurement is ready we can route the DocuSign today and target the 2025-10-20 kickoff.

—Ben
Director, Solutions & Ops | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0199

Ben / Soojin —

Thanks — procurement has signed the bundle and I confirmed with them that the payer is TerraCart. DocuSign shows the envelope completed (link included). We appreciate the credit and the clarified acceptance gates.

Procurement note: procurement@terracart.com confirms they’ll expect an invoice for any overage after the evaluation window; they have recorded the HubSpot deal id DC-3821 on their side.

Alicia
